clause: Frontend UI-state snapshot + author_id coverage audit [STU-MDL-002]

scope.summary: Extend foundation MT-009's UI-state snapshot to full frontend visibility per STU-MDL-002: audit that every operator-visible Studio surface (pane, panel, tab, tool, control, canvas) exposes a stable author_id through the AccessKit/egui tree so Argus can identify/inspect/steer it, and that machine-readable UI-state snapshots (active tool, current selection, panel/layout state, document/artboard/board focus) are queryable without pixel screen-reading. Missing author_id is recorded HBR-VIS debt.
acceptance_criteria: every Studio surface has stable author_id; UI-state snapshot queryable; coverage audit enforced
proof_targets: author_id coverage audit + UI-state query test
expected_tests: argus: author_id coverage audit enumerates all Studio surfaces + flags any missing target
live: UI-state snapshot query returns tool/selection/panel/focus without screen-read

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Model API / Frontend UI-state snapshots (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Some operator surfaces unsteerable/invisible to Argus; frontend visibility incomplete.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
